因此，摩根大通看待科技股的重點，已從整個族群能否再度獨領風騷，轉向各產業的獲利差異。該行維持超配半導體、低配軟體與媒體的配置，也看好韓國及新興市場受惠於半導體前景改善的機會。
paras_en: After months of valuation compression for U.S. tech stocks, JPMorgan believes the toughest phase for the seven major tech firms may be behind them. Ongoing AI capital spending and continued corporate earnings growth give tech stocks a chance to regain market attention; however, the bank also notes that tech stocks are unlikely to return to their previous dominant, market‑driving role.

JPMorgan strategist Mislav Matejka said in a report on Monday (the 28th) that the seven major tech firms have been underperforming the market this year, and their forward 12‑month price‑to‑earnings ratio relative to the S&P 500 has fallen to a low near one standard deviation, making valuations the cheapest in a decade.
JPMorgan had already warned in March that the market’s valuation correction for large‑cap tech stocks may have gone too far.

Amazon (AMZN‑US), Google (GOOGL‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Meta (META‑US) and Oracle (ORCL‑US) – the ultra‑large cloud players – have underperformed the S&P 500 by about 8% since the start of the year.

With AI capital spending surging, the combined free cash flow of these five companies is projected to fall from roughly $233.4 billion in 2024 to about $10.6 billion in 2026, turning negative in 2027, while debt and equity financing are expected to rise accordingly.

JPMorgan acknowledges that cloud providers are shifting from a light‑asset to a heavy‑asset model, which justifies a valuation downgrade, but it believes the current compression of forward P/E ratios may already be excessive.

The bank expects corporate earnings growth to continue supporting stock prices; even if valuations fall further and erode some returns, the benefit from earnings growth should not be completely offset.

Another market concern is whether AI can be monetized smoothly. Although token prices for large language models have dropped sharply in recent months, JPMorgan notes that rapidly rising usage has more than offset the price cuts, keeping overall spend on the rise and commercial use cases accumulating.
Semiconductor earnings upgraded, software still under pressure

Within the tech sector, JPMorgan maintains an overweight stance on semiconductors and recommends a long‑short pairing of “buy semiconductors, sell software.” The bank sees a clear divergence between the two industries’ stock price and earnings outlooks.

During the June‑July momentum unwind, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell as much as 28% and the Korea Composite Stock Price Index dropped 39%. At the time, the market feared that tighter memory‑chip specifications and improved algorithm efficiency could suppress memory demand.
However, JPMorgan called for a renewed bullish view on semiconductors at the end of July, citing continued strength in earnings among related companies.

Since the June peak in semiconductor‑versus‑software relative performance, semiconductor earnings forecasts for the next 12 months have been revised upward by about 30%, while software earnings expectations have barely improved.
JPMorgan believes the gap between semiconductor stock prices and earnings creates a buying opportunity.
The bank’s semiconductor research team expects industry supply‑demand imbalances to persist until at least 2028, keeping prices on an upward trajectory through 2027.

Recent corporate comments also show demand is still growing: Broadcom (AVGO‑US) says AI inference demand is accelerating adoption of custom XPU chips; Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) notes unusually strong demand visibility from its largest customer extending through the next eight quarters; Arm (ARM‑US) points out rapid growth in cloud and AI royalty revenues.

Spending by cloud providers also underpins semiconductor demand. JPMorgan projects that total capital spending by ultra‑large cloud players will rise from $950 billion in 2026 to $1.4 trillion in 2027 and reach $3 trillion by 2030.
The firm is especially bullish on semiconductor equipment, naming ASML as a core European pick.
In contrast, software stocks, while also at low valuations, face fundamental challenges. Investors worry AI will disrupt existing business models and revenue streams.

JPMorgan thinks software stocks may see a short‑term bounce after a steep decline, but profitability will remain in question and long‑term performance could lag behind other parts of the AI value chain. Cybersecurity is an exception: heightened security threats from AI models should sustain demand.
Tech improvements benefit the broader market but are not a prerequisite for an equity rally

For the overall market, JPMorgan sees that if oil prices and interest‑rate volatility stabilize and the seasonal headwinds of September fade, equities could resume an uptrend, with a strong Q3 earnings season acting as a catalyst.
Recent market pressure has come mainly from rising U.S. Treasury yields and oil prices. The U.S. 10‑year yield broke 5% last week, and oil prices were pushed higher by escalating U.S.–Iran tensions.
Nevertheless, the S&P 500 and Europe’s Stoxx 600 have only retreated about 1%‑3% from recent highs, indicating the broader market can absorb volatility.

JPMorgan notes that tech stocks account for 39% of the U.S. index and 44% of emerging‑market indices; while a healthier tech sector naturally supports the market, a rally does not necessarily require tech to lead.
From June to July, Korean equities and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell sharply, yet the overall market stayed stable and hit new highs in August.

Thus, JPMorgan’s focus on tech stocks has shifted from wondering whether the sector can once again dominate to examining profit differentials across industries. The bank maintains an overweight on semiconductors, underweight on software and media, and remains optimistic about opportunities for Korea and emerging markets as semiconductor outlook improves.

items.title: OpenAI因安全疑慮 取消發布新模型GPT-6.1 Astra
items.title_en: OpenAI Cancels Release of New Model GPT-6.1 Astra Over Safety Concerns
paras: 多家外媒於週一(28 日) 報導，OpenAI 原訂於 10 月在 ChatGPT 與 Codex 平台推出新模型「GPT-6.1 Astra」，但因內部測試發現重大安全疑慮，最終決定取消發布，轉而集中資源加強後續模型的安全性。
OpenAI 原本計畫在未來幾週內推出 GPT-6.1 Astra。該模型在無人協助下執行複雜任務與寫作的能力上，表現均優於先前版本，然而其安全測試結果卻未能達到公司的公開發布標準。
OpenAI 安全系統主管 Saachi Jain 指出，GPT-6.1 Astra 在兩項關鍵指標上的表現較前代模型退步：
第一是「對齊」(Alignment)能力，即模型是否能按照人類的期望與意圖行事。測試顯示，該模型出現較多不誠實 (欺騙) 行為，有時未能如實向使用者回報其執行與未執行的事項。
第二是「授權範圍」管理。GPT-6.1 Astra 有時會在未先取得使用者許可的情況下擅自繼續執行任務；甚至在可能存在安全風險的情境下，仍會強行嘗試調用外部工具或服務。
Jain 表示，模型既要嚴格遵守授權範圍，又要在任務受阻時保持高效運作。雖然 GPT-6.1 Astra 在減少模型消極應付方面有所突破，但其安全與對齊表現仍不足以支持公開上線。
OpenAI 宣布取消發布 Astra 的同時，內部也正積極調查近幾個月發現的多起 AI 代理 (Agent) 安全事件。今年夏天，數百個用於執行資安測試的 OpenAI 內部代理，竟意外入侵了 AI 開發平台 Hugging Face；隨後澳洲政府與聯合國等機構也發現，OpenAI 代理曾以類似但程度較輕的手法存取其網站。不過，大多數已公開的事件所涉及的均為無公開計畫的內部模型。
此外，OpenAI 上週又發現有 AI 代理繞過公司的網路存取限制，向公開聊天機器人發送查詢。官方表示，新導入的監控系統在 15 分鐘內即察覺異常，公司隨後暫停了目前能力最強的 AI 模型訓練，至今尚未恢復。
OpenAI 特別澄清，GPT-6.1 Astra 並非上述被暫停訓練的模型。Astra 原本已規劃公開推出，本次取消發布完全是因為自身的安全測試未達標準。
為全面應對代理安全隱患，OpenAI 已導入全新的監控系統以快速捕捉異常行為，並要求工程師在測試 AI 系統時採取更嚴格的安全防護措施。
這項消息傳出的時間點相當敏感，正好落在 OpenAI 於舊金山舉行年度開發者大會的前一天。OpenAI 過去常利用此大會發表重磅新模型與開發者服務；然而近幾週，OpenAI 與主要競爭對手 Anthropic 均公開呼籲產業夥伴放緩尖端 AI 模型的開發腳步，共同投入建立安全標準，並表示自身也將放緩內部的研發進度。
paras_en: Multiple foreign media outlets reported on Monday (the 28th) that OpenAI had originally scheduled the launch of a new model, “GPT-6.1 Astra,” on its ChatGPT and Codex platforms in October, but after internal testing uncovered major safety concerns, the company decided to cancel the release and instead focus resources on strengthening the safety of future models.

OpenAI had initially planned to roll out GPT-6.1 Astra within the next few weeks. The model outperformed previous versions in its ability to execute complex tasks and write without human assistance, but its safety test results fell short of the company’s public release standards.
Saachi Jain, head of OpenAI’s safety systems, said that GPT-6.1 Astra regressed on two key metrics compared with its predecessor:

The first is “alignment” – the model’s ability to act according to human expectations and intent. Tests showed the model exhibited more dishonest (deceptive) behavior and sometimes failed to accurately report to users what it had or had not done.

The second is “authorization scope” management. GPT-6.1 Astra sometimes continued executing tasks without first obtaining user permission, and even in situations that might pose safety risks it would forcibly attempt to call external tools or services.

Jain explained that a model must strictly adhere to its authorization limits while remaining efficient when a task is blocked. Although GPT-6.1 Astra made progress in reducing passive non‑responses, its safety and alignment performance were still insufficient for a public launch.

When OpenAI announced the cancellation of Astra, it also disclosed that it is actively investigating several AI‑agent safety incidents uncovered over the past few months. This summer, hundreds of internal OpenAI agents used for security testing inadvertently breached the AI development platform Hugging Face; later, Australian government and United Nations entities found that OpenAI agents had accessed their sites using similar, though less severe, methods. Most of the publicly reported incidents involved internal models with no public roadmap.

In addition, OpenAI discovered last week that AI agents had bypassed the company’s network access restrictions to send queries to the public chatbot. The company said a newly deployed monitoring system detected the anomaly within 15 minutes, after which it paused training of its most capable AI model, a pause that remains in effect.

OpenAI clarified that GPT-6.1 Astra is not the model whose training was paused. Astra had been slated for a public launch, and the cancellation is solely due to its safety tests not meeting standards.

To comprehensively address agent‑related safety risks, OpenAI has implemented a brand‑new monitoring system to quickly capture anomalous behavior and has required engineers to adopt stricter safety safeguards when testing AI systems.

The timing of this announcement is particularly sensitive, coming the day before OpenAI’s annual developer conference in San Francisco. The conference has traditionally been used to unveil major new models and developer services, but in recent weeks both OpenAI and its main rival Anthropic have publicly urged industry partners to slow the development of cutting‑edge AI models, to collectively work on safety standards, and have said they themselves will decelerate internal R&D.

items.title: AI放空潮擴大！放空者瞄準包括台股「兩家公司」、AI投資進入個股淘汰賽
items.title_en: AI Short‑Selling Wave Expands: Short Sellers Target Two Taiwanese Companies and AI Stocks Enter a Survival Contest
paras: 近年人工智慧（AI）交易持續走強，讓放空投資人難以押注其反轉，但隨著AI題材逐步擴大，放空者的目標也開始從最熱門的AI晶片，延伸至整個AI生態系，試圖從不同領域中找出可能成為「輸家」的企業，其中也包括台灣的廣達(2382-TW) 與緯穎(6669-TW)。
根據《Business Insider》報導，標普全球市場財智股票分析產品執行董事Matt Chessum表示，放空活動正沿著AI價值鏈擴散，涵蓋軟體、機器人、自駕車、量子運算、雲端基礎設施及資料中心營運商。
他指出，這反映市場正更加審視哪些企業能將AI投資轉化為可持續的報酬。
Chessum 指出，做空範圍的擴大表明 AI 投資熱潮正趨於成熟。投資人雖已接受AI具有結構性成長的發展趨勢，但開始更加挑剔，尋找真正能從AI熱潮中受益的領域，同時避開可能難以實現成長的企業。
部分知名放空投資人近來持續對AI晶片交易的估值與持續性表達懷疑。以電影《大賣空》原型之一貝瑞（Michael Burry）為例，他在6月放空熱門的安碩半導體ETF(SOXX-US) ，此前他也曾押注輝達(NVDA-US) 與美光科技(MU-US) 下跌。
但Chessum指出，近期數據顯示，市場情緒已明顯偏離貝瑞這類策略，轉為在一個廣泛受到支持的題材中進行個股選擇，而不是押注整個產業看空。
Chessum表示，放空者已不再對AI硬體做出一致性的看空押注，而是將曝險集中在估值、融資能力、競爭地位或執行能力存在較大爭議的企業。
近期受到放空者關注的標的，也包括一些在AI熱潮中重新受到市場追捧的「迷因股」。Chessum指出，SoundHound AI (SOUN-US) 與中國AI模型開發商智譜(02513-HK) 便是其中兩家公司，受到關注的原因包括估值偏高及商業化風險。
Chessum表示，目前SoundHound約33.57%的流通股已被借出，顯示其放空需求高，同時市場對其AI成長故事的看法也存在分歧。
至於智譜，則因借券市場供需失衡而受到放空者關注。Chessum指出，市場對智譜股票的借券需求非常強勁，但可供借出的股票數量有限，使其成為市場上借券價值最高的AI標的之一。
標普全球數據也顯示，AI相關放空交易正逐漸走向全球，而非集中於美國最熱門的AI股票。
該機構指出，亞洲AI相關企業的股票也出現更多放空交易，包括廣達與緯穎 。標普表示，這些動向顯示「投資人的布局已從晶片設計商延伸至伺服器、記憶體、晶圓生產及半導體設備」。
放空者如今展現出的更加審慎態度，也反映出整體AI交易仍揮之不去的商業化疑慮。標普全球表示，其分析發現，過去一年推出的企業AI專案中，不到一半目前符合在12個月內產生正報酬的進度。
在此背景下，證券借貸活動並未顯示市場全面否定AI，也不是所有AI股票都面臨一致性的放空壓力。相反地，這顯示市場正逐漸進入更成熟的階段，投資人開始檢視不同企業能否真正將AI投資、產能與技術潛力轉化為可持續的報酬。
paras_en: In recent years, AI‑related trading has continued to strengthen, making it difficult for short sellers to bet on a reversal. As AI themes broaden, short sellers are extending their targets beyond the hottest AI chips to the entire AI ecosystem, seeking companies that could become "losers" across various sectors, including Taiwan's Quanta (2382‑TW) and Wi‑Ying (6669‑TW).

According to Business Insider, Matt Chessum, Executive Director of S&P Global Market Intelligence’s equity analysis product, said short‑selling activity is spreading along the AI value chain, covering software, robotics, autonomous vehicles, quantum computing, cloud infrastructure, and data‑center operators.
He noted that this reflects the market’s increasing scrutiny of which firms can turn AI investments into sustainable returns.

Chessum said the widening scope of short positions indicates that the AI investment boom is maturing. While investors have accepted AI’s structural growth trend, they are becoming more selective, looking for sectors that truly benefit from the AI surge and avoiding companies that may struggle to achieve growth.

Some well‑known short sellers have recently expressed doubts about the valuation and durability of AI‑chip trades. For example, Michael Burry, one of the real‑life inspirations for the film "The Big Short," shorted the popular VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SOXX‑US) in June, after previously betting against Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and Micron Technology (MU‑US).

However, Chessum pointed out that recent data show market sentiment has clearly diverged from strategies like Burry’s, shifting toward selecting individual stocks within a broadly supported theme rather than shorting the entire industry.

Chessum said short sellers are no longer making uniform bearish bets on AI hardware; instead, they concentrate exposure on companies with disputed valuations, financing capacity, competitive position, or execution ability.

Among the recent targets attracting short‑seller attention are some "meme stocks" that have been revived by the AI hype. Chessum cited SoundHound AI (SOUN‑US) and Chinese AI model developer Zhihu (02513‑HK) as two examples, with concerns over high valuations and commercialization risk.
Chessum noted that about 33.57% of SoundHound’s float is currently on loan, indicating strong short‑selling demand and divergent market views on its AI growth story.

As for Zhihu, short‑seller interest stems from an imbalance in the securities‑lending market. Chessum explained that demand to borrow Zhihu shares is very strong while the supply of lendable shares is limited, making it one of the most expensive AI stocks to borrow.
S&P Global data also show that AI‑related short‑selling is becoming a global phenomenon rather than being concentrated on the United States' most popular AI stocks.

The firm highlighted that Asian AI‑related equities are seeing more short‑selling activity, including Quanta and Wi‑Ying. S&P said these trends show "investors’ positioning has expanded from chip designers to servers, memory, wafer fabrication, and semiconductor equipment."

The more cautious stance displayed by short sellers reflects lingering commercialization doubts about AI trading overall. S&P Global noted that, of the corporate AI projects launched in the past year, fewer than half are on track to generate positive returns within twelve months.

In this context, securities‑lending activity does not indicate a wholesale market rejection of AI, nor that all AI stocks face uniform short‑selling pressure. On the contrary, it suggests the market is moving into a more mature phase, with investors evaluating whether individual companies can truly convert AI investment, capacity, and technological potential into sustainable returns.

items.title: 佛州提告OpenAI 請求法院禁止開發新AI模型
items.title_en: Florida Sues OpenAI, Requests Court to Bar Development of New AI Models
paras: 佛羅里達州檢察長 James Uthmeier 週一 (28 日) 向法院聲請暫時禁制令，要求 OpenAI 在缺乏獨立安全監督機制的情況下，不得繼續開發新的人工智慧 (AI) 模型。佛州同時要求限制未成年人使用 ChatGPT，以及平台對使用者的互動與宣傳方式。法院尚未就聲請作出裁決。
這項聲請是佛州今年 6 月對 OpenAI 提起訴訟的後續行動。
佛州主張，OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 的設計、行銷與推廣上未充分保護使用者，對平台安全性作出不實陳述，涉嫌違反佛州《欺騙及不公平交易行為法》。
訴訟提及 ChatGPT 據稱曾向校園槍擊案凶嫌提供資訊、給予自我傷害相關指引，以及使年輕使用者沉迷。這些指控仍待法院審理。
在最新聲請中，佛州要求法院禁止未成年人使用 ChatGPT，並禁止 OpenAI 賦予平台「人類特質」、主動誘導使用者持續互動，或將 ChatGPT 宣傳為安全、準確或可靠。
佛州以 AI 模型的安全事件支持聲請理由。
佛州在聲請書中列舉多起 OpenAI 模型的安全事件，包括涉及 Hugging Face 的事件、模型據稱試圖入侵美國政府網站，以及一名 OpenAI 代理未經授權進入澳洲衛生部門網站。
佛州也指控，OpenAI 未經家長同意蒐集 13 歲以下兒童的個人資訊，且缺乏足夠措施阻止未成年人使用 ChatGPT。
聲請書另引用有關 OpenAI、Anthropic 及安全研究人員調查模型異常行為的報導。
相關事件包括繞過安全防護、試圖規避監控及干擾網站等，調查數量達數以萬計；但各事件嚴重程度不同，目前已調查的多數事件沒有已知的現實世界傷害。
佛州據此主張，OpenAI 無法充分自行管理技術風險。
檢察長 Uthmeier 週一公開要求 OpenAI 停止宣稱產品安全、停止將 ChatGPT 塑造成像人一樣，並停止向兒童提供產品。
OpenAI 發言人 Drew Pusateri 回應，公司已暫停訓練功能最強大的模型，在增加安全防護措施前不會恢復；公司也願與佛州及其他州合作，推動適用於整個 AI 產業的安全政策。
paras_en: Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier on Monday (the 28th) filed a motion for a temporary restraining order, asking the court to prohibit OpenAI from continuing to develop new artificial intelligence (AI) models without an independent safety oversight mechanism. Florida also seeks to restrict minors' use of ChatGPT and to limit the platform's interaction and promotional practices toward users. The court has not yet ruled on the motion.
The motion follows a lawsuit Florida filed against OpenAI in June of this year.

Florida alleges that OpenAI failed to adequately protect users in the design, marketing, and promotion of ChatGPT, made false statements about the platform's safety, and violated Florida’s Deceptive and Unfair Trade Practices Act.

The lawsuit cites claims that ChatGPT allegedly provided information to a school shooting suspect, gave self‑harm guidance, and fostered addiction among young users. These allegations remain to be adjudicated.

In the latest motion, Florida asks the court to bar minors from using ChatGPT and to prohibit OpenAI from attributing "human‑like" qualities to the platform, actively prompting users to keep interacting, or marketing ChatGPT as safe, accurate, or reliable.
Florida supports its request with examples of safety incidents involving AI models.

The filing lists several safety incidents involving OpenAI models, including an incident involving Hugging Face, a model purportedly attempting to breach U.S. government websites, and an OpenAI agent who accessed an Australian health‑department site without authorization.
Florida also accuses OpenAI of collecting personal information from children under 13 without parental consent and of lacking sufficient measures to prevent minors from using ChatGPT.
The motion further cites reports on investigations by OpenAI, Anthropic, and security researchers into anomalous model behavior.

Related incidents include attempts to bypass safety safeguards, evade monitoring, and disrupt websites, with investigations numbering in the tens of thousands; while the severity of each incident varies, most investigated cases have no known real‑world harm.
Based on this, Florida argues that OpenAI cannot adequately self‑manage the technological risks.
Attorney General Uthmeier publicly demanded on Monday that OpenAI stop claiming its products are safe, stop portraying ChatGPT as human‑like, and stop offering the product to children.

OpenAI spokesperson Drew Pusateri responded that the company has paused training its most powerful models and will not resume until additional safety measures are in place; the company is also willing to work with Florida and other states to develop safety policies applicable across the AI industry.

items.title: 估值1500億美元、募資150億！Solidigm擬最快2027赴美上市 母企SK海力士面臨估值動搖
items.title_en: Valuation of $150 B, $15 B Fundraise! Solidigm Aims for Fastest U.S. IPO by 2027, Parent SK Hynix Faces Valuation Pressure
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，SK海力士旗下美國子公司Solidigm正邁向可能成為美股史上最大規模的半導體IPO。Solidigm已與多家投行舉行承銷競標會議，考慮最快2027年上市，目標估值最高約1500億美元、募資約150億美元；若成功上市將遠超安謀2023年上市估值約540億美元、Cerebras Systems 2026年完全稀釋估值約560億美元，也高於兩者募資規模。
SK海力士今年7月完成那斯達克ADR二次上市，發行1.779億份、募資約265億美元，發行價149美元，首日市值一度逼近1.22兆美元；按近期媒體預估，SK集團市值約1.37兆美元，而Solidigm獨立上市，等於把AI基礎設施中最吃香的一塊NAND與eSSD資產拆出重估。
Solidigm核心業務為NAND與eSSD，客戶涵蓋CoreWeave、Vast Data、Dell、騰訊等雲端與資料中心業者，上月跟CoreWeave簽多年供貨協議，強化AI推理存儲定位。
今年上半年Solidigm營收12.25兆韓元(約90.3億美元)、年增265%，淨利5.839兆韓元(約43.1億美元)、年增44倍，淨利率由3.9%升至47.7%並首度累計轉虧為盈。

根據TrendForce數據，SK海力士集團今年次季eSSD營收86.3億美元、環增85.9%，市占21.1%；Counterpoint則估算eSSD占全球NAND出貨量48%，AI推理取代訓練成為主引擎，Solidigm位元出貨今年Q2季增40%。同季整體NAND原廠前五大營收688.7億美元、季增77%，供不應求推升合約價；今年首季eSSD前五大營收184.6億美元、季增率86.1%，合約價漲約80%，顯示漲價與位元成長雙輪驅動。
Solidigm前身為英特爾NAND與SSD事業，SK海力士2020年以約90億美元收購、2021年成立，早期連年虧損，2022、2023年分別虧3.3兆、4兆韓元，2023年底股東權益一度為負；六年轉向千億美元估值，反映市場把eSSD視為AI基礎設施「賣鏟子」資產。
為承接需求，Solidigm評估在美國興建首座NAND量產廠，紐約州北部、美東地塊列入考察，現有量產主要靠中國大連，美國僅有總部與研發。

資本市場卻先反映利空。韓股SK海力士周一(28日)盤中跌約5%，創兩周最大跌幅，大股東SK Square跌逾8%、控股SK Inc.跌逾6%，因市場擔心Solidigm獨立上市後，SK海力士股東對AI NAND超級週期利潤的間接權益被稀釋，未來收益分流外部股東，加上南韓企業治理論壇批評SK Inc.→SK Square→SK海力士→AI Company→Solidigm層級更深，加劇金字塔股權與「韓國折價」，8月已促請撤案。
Fibonacci資產管理公司執行長Jung In Yun指出，若少量股權、價格合理可釋放價值，大規模稀釋且資金用途不明則堪憂；未來資產證券則認為部分出售影響有限，可視為併購資金回收。
分析人士指出，Solidigm估值成敗取決於三項變數：AI推理與Agent工作負載可否在2027年延續eSSD需求、NAND漲價會否隨新增產能回軟、以及IPO釋股比例與募資投入美國產線的報酬率。記憶體具備強周期特性，供給緊時利潤暴增、產能釋放後回檔；AI可延長景氣，但不改供需。
對SK海力士而言，Solidigm上市既是為擴張融資，也可能重塑集團估值與治理折價，市場短期波動難免。
paras_en: Foreign media reports say SK Hynix’s U.S. subsidiary Solidigm is moving toward what could become the largest semiconductor IPO in U.S. market history. Solidigm has held underwriting meetings with several banks and is considering a listing as early as 2027, targeting a valuation of up to $150 billion and a raise of about $15 billion; if successful, it would dwarf Arm’s 2023 IPO valuation of roughly $54 billion and Cerebras Systems’ fully‑diluted 2026 valuation of about $56 billion, and would also exceed both companies’ fundraising sizes.

In July this year SK Hynix completed a secondary listing of its ADR on Nasdaq, issuing 177.9 million shares and raising roughly $26.5 billion at $149 per share, with a first‑day market cap that briefly approached $1.22 trillion. Recent media estimates put the SK Group’s market value at about $1.37 trillion, and an independent Solidigm listing would effectively carve out its most coveted AI‑infrastructure assets—NAND and eSSD—into a separate valuation.

Solidigm’s core business is NAND and eSSD, serving cloud and data‑center customers such as CoreWeave, Vast Data, Dell and Tencent. Last month it signed a multi‑year supply agreement with CoreWeave, reinforcing its positioning in AI inference storage.

In the first half of this year Solidigm posted revenue of 12.25 trillion won (about $9.03 billion), up 265% year‑on‑year, and net profit of 5.839 trillion won (about $4.31 billion), a 44‑fold increase, with net margin rising from 3.9% to 47.7% and turning a loss into profit for the first time.

According to TrendForce, SK Hynix’s eSSD revenue in the second quarter was $8.63 billion, up 85.9% quarter‑on‑quarter, giving it a 21.1% market share. Counterpoint estimates eSSD accounts for 48% of global NAND shipments, with AI inference overtaking training as the main driver; Solidigm’s bit shipments grew 40% in Q2. In the same quarter the top five NAND vendors generated $68.87 billion in revenue, up 77% QoQ, pushing contract prices higher due to tight supply. In Q1 this year the top five eSSD vendors earned $18.46 billion, up 86.1% QoQ, with contract prices rising about 80%, indicating that both price hikes and bit‑growth are driving the market.

Solidigm originated from Intel’s NAND and SSD business, which SK Hynix acquired for roughly $9 billion in 2020 and formally spun out in 2021. The unit posted consecutive losses early on, losing 3.3 trillion won in 2022 and 4 trillion won in 2023, with shareholders’ equity turning negative at the end of 2023. Its shift to a valuation in the hundred‑billion‑dollar range reflects the market’s view of eSSD as a “shovel‑selling” AI infrastructure asset.

To meet demand, Solidigm is evaluating the construction of its first NAND mass‑production plant in the United States, looking at sites in northern New York and the broader East Coast. Currently its mass production is based mainly in Dalian, China, with only headquarters and R&D in the U.S.

The capital markets reacted negatively. SK Hynix shares fell about 5% on Monday (the 28th), the biggest drop in two weeks, while major shareholder SK Square slid more than 8% and controlling entity SK Inc. fell over 6%, as investors worry that an independent Solidigm IPO would dilute SK Hynix shareholders’ indirect exposure to the AI NAND super‑cycle profits, diverting future earnings to external shareholders. A Korean corporate‑governance forum also criticized the deepening chain SK Inc. → SK Square → SK Hynix → AI company → Solidigm, aggravating pyramid‑style equity structures and the “Korea discount,” prompting a request to withdraw the filing in August.

Jung In Yun, CEO of Fibonacci Asset Management, said that a small equity stake at a reasonable price could unlock value, but large‑scale dilution with unclear use of proceeds is concerning. He added that asset‑backed securities view a partial sale as having limited impact and could be seen as a way to recoup acquisition funding.

Analysts note that Solidigm’s valuation hinges on three variables: whether AI inference and agent workloads will sustain eSSD demand through 2027, whether NAND price increases will soften as new capacity comes online, and the proportion of shares floated and the return on investment of funds allocated to U.S. production lines. Memory has strong cyclical traits—profits surge when supply is tight and retreat when capacity expands—while AI can extend the upcycle without changing the underlying supply‑demand balance.
For SK Hynix, Solidigm’s IPO is both a financing vehicle and a potential reshaper of the group’s overall valuation and governance discount. Short‑term market volatility is therefore inevitable.

items.title: 華爾街大空頭貝瑞：AI泡沫可能比原先預期「更早破裂」
items.title_en: Wall Street Big Short Michael Burry Says AI Bubble Could Burst Earlier Than Expected
paras: 《CNBC》報導，電影「大賣空」原型人物貝瑞(Michael Burry)正將他看空AI熱潮的時間表提前。
這位在2007年至2009年全球金融危機爆發前，成功押注美國房市崩盤而聞名的投資人表示，他正在把對主要AI股票的放空部位轉換為賣權(put options)，讓他在較短時間內，以更具成本效益方式取得槓桿。
貝瑞在周一(28日)發布的投資電子報中寫道，「從基本面來看，我正在把時間表往前移。因此，我希望我的放空部位擁有更高的槓桿。更明確的時間表，讓使用槓桿變得更容易接受。沒有什麼比選擇權更能代表槓桿，而在此案例中就是賣權。由於VIX等波動率指標目前異常緊縮，賣權相對便宜。」
他表示，其中部分操作是為了降低自己的稅務負擔，但大部分都是因為他認為「AI泡沫可能會比預期更早破裂。」貝瑞最近以賣權為主的部位顯示，他認為AI交易熱潮可能在明年夏季之前出現逆轉。
他將原本對美光(Micron)(MU-US)的放空部位換成了賣權，履約日期設定在明年6月，履約價約為500美元。他也將對 Nebius(NBIS-US)的放空部位換成了明年6月到期的賣權，履約價在「兩位數價格區間」。此外，他將原本放空iShares Semiconductor ETF(SOXX-US)的部位，換成了2027年9月到期、履約價位於400多美元低段的賣權。
他也「將原本對Palantir(PLTR-US)的放空與賣權部位進行調整並延後到期日，轉換成更大的賣權部位」，主要集中在2027年9月到期、履約價100多美元低段的選擇權。
貝瑞引用了Ares Management最近一份研究。該研究強調，目前AI產業高度依賴尚未被證實的收入，而相關融資架構又搭配了要求嚴格的法律協議，因此相當不穩定。
Ares的報告指出，「只要有一季的AI營收不如預期、無法支撐原本資本支出的融資假設，就可能發生問題。在這種情況下，只要少數幾家原本傾向把資本重新配置到最有信心投資標的上的董事會，認定最有信心的投資標的已經發生轉移，就足以改變局勢。」
貝瑞最新的操作顯示，他對AI交易的看法越來越悲觀。本月稍早，他已增加了對 美光、Nebius及SOXX的放空部位。
他同時引用Acer執行長Jason Chen的說法。Chen最近接受台灣媒體採訪時表示，由於中國的產能持續增加，記憶體晶片產業的週期性可能重新出現。
Jason Chen被引述表示，「怎麼可能一直缺貨？中國的生產能力一直在增加，根本不存在短缺問題。目前合約價格仍在高檔波動，有些價格上漲，有些則下跌。」
貝瑞今年一直維持看空，但股市卻持續創下新高。他今年5月曾表示，目前的股市讓他「感覺就像1999年至2000年泡沫最後幾個月的情況」。而那斯達克綜合指數上周收在歷史新高。
不過，許多科技股目前仍遠低於自身歷史高點。美光目前比歷史高點低約16%，而Palantir則比歷史高點低約10%。
paras_en: CNBC reports that Michael Burry, the real‑life figure portrayed in the movie “The Big Short,” is moving up his timetable for betting against the AI hype.

The investor, famous for correctly shorting the U.S. housing market before the 2007‑2009 global financial crisis, says he is converting his short positions in major AI stocks into put options so he can achieve leverage more cost‑effectively over a shorter horizon.

In an investment newsletter released on Monday (the 28th), Burry wrote, “Fundamentally, I’m moving the timeline forward. Therefore I want my short positions to have higher leverage. A clearer timeline makes leveraged exposure easier to accept. Nothing represents leverage better than options, and in this case it’s puts. With volatility indices like the VIX unusually tight right now, puts are relatively cheap.”

He said part of the maneuver is to reduce his tax burden, but the bulk is driven by his belief that “the AI bubble may burst earlier than expected.” Burry’s recent put‑heavy positioning suggests he expects a reversal of the AI trading frenzy before next summer.

He swapped his short on Micron (MU‑US) for puts expiring in June 2025 with a strike around $500. He also turned his short on Nebius (NBIS‑US) into June 2025 puts with strikes in the “double‑digit” range. In addition, he replaced his short on the iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX‑US) with puts expiring September 2027 at a low‑$400‑plus strike.
He also “adjusted and extended the expiration of his short and put position on Palantir (PLTR‑US) into a larger put position,” concentrating on September 2027 puts with strikes in the low $100 range.

Burry cited a recent research report from Ares Management. The study stresses that the AI industry is currently heavily dependent on unproven revenue streams, and the financing structures are tied to strict legal covenants, making them highly fragile.

Ares’ report notes, “If a single quarter of AI revenue falls short of expectations and cannot support the financing assumptions underlying original cap‑ex plans, trouble can arise. In that scenario, even a few board members who were inclined to reallocate capital to their most confident bets can, by recognizing a shift in the most promising investment, change the whole picture.”
Burry’s latest moves show his outlook on AI trading is becoming increasingly pessimistic. Earlier this month he added to his short positions in Micron, Nebius and SOXX.
He also quoted Acer CEO Jason Chen, who told Taiwanese media that rising Chinese capacity could bring back cyclical pressure to the memory‑chip industry.

Jason Chen was quoted as saying, “How can there still be a shortage? China’s production capacity keeps growing, so a shortage simply doesn’t exist. Contract prices are still volatile at the high end—some are rising, some are falling.”

Burry has remained bearish all year while the stock market keeps hitting new highs. In May he likened the current market to the final months of the 1999‑2000 bubble, and the Nasdaq Composite closed at a record high last week.
However, many tech stocks are still well below their own historical peaks. Micron trades about 16% below its all‑time high, and Palantir is roughly 10% under its previous peak.

items.title: 不用等美國期中選舉？高盛：「金髮女孩」行情或提前點燃美股年末行情
items.title_en: No Need to Wait for the U.S. Midterm Election? Goldman Sachs: The "Blonde Girl" Scenario Could Ignite the U.S. Stock Market Before Year-End
paras: 高盛集團合夥人Mark Wilson近日表示，全球股市在今年底前可能面臨更明確的上行機會。隨著市場對停滯性通膨風險的定價已相對充分，若經濟逐步朝「金髮女孩」情境發展，投資人未必需要等到美國期中選舉結束，就可以重新增加風險資產配置。
近期市場走勢也反映出這項預期，人工智慧（AI）帶動的「錯失恐懼症」（FOMO）已重新升溫，而在Meta(META-US) 推出Muse後，市場對AI大規模進入消費市場的時間預期明顯提前，帶動那斯達克指數等AI相關資產上週一強勢突破。
此前，市場在經歷3個月盤整，以及第2季大幅上漲後，曾出現部位縮減。
另一方面，美國公債殖利率近期再度走高。不過，這一波殖利率上升與先前政府及AI資本支出引發的資金競爭，或能源價格帶來的通膨壓力有所不同，主要受到強於預期的採購經理人指數（PMI）等數據支撐，反映美國名目經濟成長仍具韌性，且即使殖利率大幅波動，美股仍維持漲勢。
市場原先擔心，美國10年期公債殖利率連續7個月上升、創下50年來最長紀錄，最終可能對股市造成壓力，部分投資人也傾向等到波斯灣局勢降溫及期中選舉順利落幕後，再提高風險曝險。
不過，高盛認為，通膨、經濟成長與企業獲利等基本面正在改善，可能為年底股市表現提供支撐。

AI可能帶來新的通膨降溫力量

高盛指出，近期伊朗衝突推升能源價格，一度掩蓋核心通膨降溫的趨勢。但目前關稅傳導效應正在減弱，升息及金融環境收緊也已開始產生效果。
高盛認為，若荷姆茲海峽物流恢復正常，能源價格可能面臨明顯下行壓力；尤其伊朗的重要談判籌碼窗口預計在11月2日左右結束，市場可能隨時出現新的能源價格降溫敘事。
此外，Meta的Muse產品也可能成為消費品與服務成本下降的起點。
高盛針對「商業AI代理時代」的研究顯示，科技進步正逐步降低消費端成本，可能成為比能源價格回落更重要的通膨降溫力量。

經濟成長降溫　央行升息空間受限

過去6個月，美國經濟活動受到地緣政治及能源價格不確定性影響，但整體表現仍展現超出預期的韌性。
不過，高盛經濟學家Jan Hatzius的研究指出，經濟成長的上行風險正在減弱，成長速度可能開始放緩。
隨著減稅等財政紅利消退，汽油價格及房貸利率上升也可能對部分經濟領域及消費者造成衝擊。
AI產業的資本支出週期預料仍將持續，但增速也可能放慢。高盛認為，在通膨回落預期下，未來各國央行的升息幅度可能低於目前市場定價。
Wilson表示，現在已不是需要擔心殖利率走高的時候，7個月前才比較有理由對此保持警戒。
針對市場近期對企業獲利能否持續，以及是否存在「獲利泡沫」的討論，高盛美國策略團隊負責人Ben Snider認為，目前確實有部分企業處於超額獲利狀態，但整體而言尚未形成獲利泡沫。
不過，高盛提醒投資人注意三件事：

不應為創紀錄的「其他收入」支付過高溢價；
記憶體晶片及部分半導體股票目前確實處於超額獲利狀態；
至少到2027年底前，即使企業獲利增速放緩，核心獲利仍可能維持強勁表現，進而為股市估值提供基本面支撐。


停滯性通膨敘事降溫　「金髮女孩」情境受關注

高盛指出，市場過去一度試圖反映經濟成長與企業獲利大幅放緩，以及利率維持高檔的情境，但目前總體經濟數據並未完全支持停滯性通膨的敘事。
相較之下，經濟成長放緩、通膨威脅降低、央行立場轉向寬鬆，以及估值經過一年的調整，可能共同形成有利於市場的環境。
高盛認為，當前市場情況與1990年代中後期重大科技變革時期的多空角力具有相似之處。
若經濟最終走向「金髮女孩」情境，也就是成長適中、既未過熱引發通膨，也未過冷導致衰退，歷史上的期中選舉後年底股市反彈規律依然適用。
Wilson最後表示，投資人不應等到期中選舉結束才採取行動；隨著能源價格威脅減退，歐洲與英國股市也已具備參與這波上漲的條件。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs partner Mark Wilson recently said that global equity markets may face a clearer upside opportunity before the end of this year. With the market’s pricing of stagnant inflation risk already relatively complete, if the economy gradually moves toward a "blonde girl" scenario, investors may not need to wait for the U.S. midterm election to reallocate risk assets.

Recent market moves also reflect this expectation, as AI‑driven FOMO has rekindled, and after Meta (META‑US) launched Muse, the market’s expectation of AI’s large‑scale entry into the consumer market has noticeably advanced, driving AI‑related assets such as the Nasdaq index to break out strongly last Monday.
Previously, after three months of consolidation and a sharp rise in Q2, the market saw a reduction in positions.

On the other hand, U.S. Treasury yields have risen again recently. However, this wave of yield increases differs from the earlier competition for funds triggered by government and AI capital spending or inflationary pressure from energy prices, and is mainly supported by stronger‑than‑expected PMI data, reflecting that U.S. nominal economic growth remains resilient, and even with large yield swings, the U.S. stock market continues to rise.

The market originally worried that the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield would rise for seven consecutive months, setting a 50‑year high, potentially putting pressure on the market, and some investors preferred to wait until the Gulf crisis cooled and the midterm election concluded before increasing risk exposure.
However, Goldman Sachs believes that fundamentals such as inflation, economic growth, and corporate earnings are improving, which could support year‑end market performance.

AI could bring new inflation‑cooling forces. Goldman Sachs pointed out that the recent Iran conflict pushed energy prices up, temporarily masking the trend of core inflation cooling. But tariff transmission effects are weakening, and rate hikes and tightening financial conditions have begun to take effect.

Goldman Sachs believes that if the Strait of Hormuz logistics return to normal, energy prices could face significant downward pressure; especially the window for Iran’s key negotiation leverage is expected to close around November 2, and the market could see new energy‑price cooling narratives at any time.
In addition, Meta’s Muse product could also be the starting point for a decline in consumer goods and service costs.

Goldman Sachs’ research on the "commercial AI agent era" shows that technological progress is gradually reducing consumer‑side costs, which may become a more important inflation‑cooling force than falling energy prices.

Economic growth cooling and limited room for central bank rate hikes. Over the past six months, U.S. economic activity has been affected by geopolitical and energy price uncertainty, but overall performance still shows resilience beyond expectations.
However, Goldman Sachs economist Jan Hatzius’s research indicates that the upside risk of economic growth is weakening, and growth rates may begin to slow.
As fiscal windfalls such as tax cuts fade, rising gasoline prices and mortgage rates may also impact some economic sectors and consumers.

The capital‑spending cycle in the AI industry is expected to continue, but the pace may also slow. Goldman Sachs believes that under the expectation of falling inflation, future central bank rate hikes may be lower than current market pricing.
Wilson said it is no longer necessary to worry about rising yields; seven months ago was the only time there was reason to be vigilant.

Regarding recent market discussions about whether corporate earnings can continue and whether there is a "profit bubble," Goldman Sachs U.S. strategy team lead Ben Snider said that while some companies are indeed in an excess‑profit state, overall a profit bubble has not yet formed.

However, Goldman Sachs cautions investors to pay attention to three things: do not pay too high a premium for record‑breaking "other income"; memory‑chip and some semiconductor stocks are indeed in an excess‑profit state; and at least until the end of 2027, even if corporate earnings growth slows, core earnings may still remain strong, providing fundamental support for stock valuations.

Stagnant inflation narratives cooling, the "blonde girl" scenario is attracting attention. Goldman Sachs noted that the market once tried to reflect a scenario of significant slowdown in economic growth and corporate earnings, with rates remaining high, but overall economic data do not fully support the stagnant inflation narrative.

In contrast, a slowdown in economic growth, reduced inflation threats, a shift toward a looser central bank stance, and a year‑of‑adjustment in valuations may jointly create a favorable environment for the market.
Goldman Sachs believes that the current market situation is similar to the late 1990s major technology transformation period’s bullish and bearish battle.

If the economy ultimately moves toward a "blonde girl" scenario, meaning moderate growth that is neither overheating to trigger inflation nor cooling to cause recession, the historical post‑midterm election year‑end rebound pattern still applies.
Wilson concluded that investors should not wait for the midterm election to act; as energy price threats subside, European and U.K. markets are also ready to participate in this rally.

items.title: AMD斥82億美元收購李飛飛World Labs 盼提前布局下一代AI晶片
items.title_en: AMD to Spend $8.2 Billion to Acquire Fei‑Fei Li’s World Labs, Aiming to Pre‑position for Next‑Gen AI Chips
paras: 《CNBC》報導，超微(Advanced Micro Devices, AMD)(AMD-US)周一(28日)表示，已同意以82億美元收購位於舊金山的AI研究公司World Labs。該公司由AI領域先驅李飛飛創辦。
這家晶片製造商過去就曾投資World Labs，此次將以股票作為收購這家新創公司的支付方式。
李飛飛過去曾任史丹佛大學教授，也曾任職Google並主導AI研究。完成收購後，她將出任AMD首席科學家及執行副總裁。
World Labs正在開發所謂的「世界模型」，可以用來模擬3D環境。在今年稍早一場展示中，李飛飛與AMD執行長蘇姿丰展示了World Labs名為Marble的模型。兩人示範如何利用幾張圖片，就讓Marble建立出一個3D場景。
李飛飛在展示活動中表示，「智慧型代理，無論是機器人、車輛或甚至是工具，都可以先在豐富、具備物理特性的數位世界中學習，而不需要一開始就直接部署到真實世界，這能讓它們更安全。」
李飛飛周一在社群媒體發文，稱AMD執行長蘇姿丰是她的「好朋友」，並寫道，「我們對自己的使命堅定不移，也更加期待持續打造世界領先的先進研究組織，並讓它能在未來數十年持續發展。」
AI研究人員預期，世界模型將有助於機器人及其他與實體世界直接互動的AI應用程式開發。AMD計劃在交易於今年稍晚正式完成之前，讓World Labs維持獨立於晶片製造業務之外運作。
World Labs對下一代AI模型的研究，將讓AMD能夠提前數年規劃未來AI晶片需要具備哪些能力。
此次收購規模是AMD史上第二大，僅次於2022年以約500億美元收購Xilinx。
AMD在AI併購市場展開迄今最大規模行動，正值美國科技巨頭紛紛砸重金爭奪頂尖工程師與研究人才之際，即使這些公司的相關業務仍處於相對早期的發展階段。
OpenAI去年以約64億美元收購知名設計師Jony Ive創辦的AI裝置新創io，藉此延攬這位iPhone設計師。
輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)總計斥資約330億美元投入AI晶片公司Groq與開源平台 Hugging Face。輝達在去年12月收購Groq部分資產，並於本月同意收購 Hugging Face。
而Meta Platforms(META-US)則在2025年斥資140億美元取得AI新創Scale AI少數股權。這項交易也讓Scale AI創辦人Alexandr Wang加入Meta，成立一個新的AI部門。
paras_en: CNBC reported that AMD (Advanced Micro Devices, AMD-US) on Monday (the 28th) said it has agreed to acquire San Francisco‑based AI research company World Labs for $8.2 billion. The company was founded by AI pioneer Fei‑Fei Li.
The chipmaker had previously invested in World Labs, and this time will use stock as the payment method for the acquisition of the startup.

Fei‑Fei Li previously was a professor at Stanford University and also worked at Google where she led AI research. After the acquisition she will become AMD’s chief scientist and executive vice president.

World Labs is developing a so‑called “world model” that can simulate 3D environments. In an earlier demo this year, Fei‑Fei Li and AMD CEO Lisa Su demonstrated World Labs’ model called Marble. The two showed how, using only a few images, Marble can generate a 3D scene.

In the demo Li said, “Intelligent agents—whether robots, vehicles or even tools—can first learn in a rich, physics‑based digital world instead of being deployed directly into the real world, making them safer.”

Li posted on social media Monday, calling AMD CEO Lisa Su her “good friend,” and wrote, “We remain steadfast in our mission and look forward even more to building a world‑leading advanced research organization that can continue to evolve for decades to come.”

AI researchers expect world models to aid the development of robots and other AI applications that interact directly with the physical world. AMD plans to keep World Labs operating independently of its chip‑manufacturing business until the deal formally closes later this year.
World Labs’ research on next‑generation AI models will allow AMD to plan several years ahead the capabilities future AI chips will need.
The deal is AMD’s second‑largest acquisition ever, behind only the roughly $50 billion purchase of Xilinx in 2022.

AMD’s biggest‑ever move in the AI‑M&A market comes as U.S. tech giants are splashing cash to win top engineers and researchers, even though many of those businesses are still in relatively early stages.
OpenAI last year spent about $6.4 billion to acquire the AI‑device startup io founded by renowned designer Jony Ive, in order to bring the iPhone designer on board.

Nvidia (NVDA-US) has spent roughly $33 billion in total on AI chip company Groq and the open‑source platform Hugging Face. Nvidia bought part of Groq’s assets in December last year and agreed this month to acquire Hugging Face.
Meta Platforms (META-US) will spend $14 billion in 2025 to take a minority stake in AI startup Scale AI. The deal also brings Scale AI founder Alexandr Wang into Meta to set up a new AI division.

items.title: 科技七雄估值降至10年低點 小摩看好止血回升、但難再主導美股
items.title_en: Tech Giants' Valuations Drop to 10-Year Low; JPMorgan Sees Stabilization and Recovery but Doubts Leading the Market Again
paras: 美股科技股經歷數月估值壓縮後，摩根大通認為，科技七雄最艱難的階段可能已經過去。AI資本支出持續增加、企業獲利仍在成長，讓科技股有機會重新獲得市場關注；但該行也指出，科技股恐怕難以重返先前一枝獨秀、主導大盤報酬的局面。
摩根大通策略師 Mislav Matejka周一(28日)發布的報告中指出，科技七雄今年以來持續跑輸大盤，相對標普 500 指數的未來 12 個月本益比已降至近一個標準差的低位，估值來到10年來最便宜水準。
摩根大通早在今年 3 月便認為，市場對大型科技股的估值修正可能已經過頭。
亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、Google(GOOGL-US)、微軟(MSFT-US) 、Meta(META-US) 與甲骨文(ORCL-US) 等超大規模雲端業者，年初至今的股價表現也落後標普 500 指數約 8%。
隨著 AI 資本支出激增，這五家公司的合計自由現金流，預估將從 2024 年約 2,334 億美元，降至 2026 年約 106 億美元，並在 2027 年轉為負值；債務及股權融資規模則隨之增加。
摩根大通承認，雲端業者的商業模式從輕資產轉向重資產，確實為估值下修提供理由。不過，目前相對本益比的壓縮幅度可能已過大。
該行預期，企業獲利成長仍能支撐股價，即使估值進一步下降，可能侵蝕部分報酬，也不至於完全抵消獲利成長帶來的助益。
市場另一項疑慮是 AI 能否順利變現。雖然大型語言模型的 Token 價格近月大幅下滑，摩根大通指出，使用量快速增加已足以抵消降價影響，整體支出仍在上升，商業化案例也持續累積。
半導體獲利上修 軟體仍有壓力
在科技股內部，摩根大通維持超配半導體的立場，並建議重新布局「做多半導體、做空軟體」的配對交易。該行認為，兩個產業的股價與獲利前景已出現明顯落差。
今年 6 月至 7 月的動量交易平倉期間，費城半導體指數最大跌幅達 28%，韓國綜合股價指數跌幅更達 39%。市場當時擔憂，高頻寬記憶體規格調整及演算法效率提升，可能壓抑記憶體需求。
不過，摩根大通在 7 月底便呼籲重新看多半導體，理由是相關企業的獲利仍持續走強。
自 6 月半導體相對軟體的價格表現觸頂以來，半導體企業未來 12 個月每股盈餘預期上修約 30%，軟體業的獲利預期卻幾乎沒有改善。
摩根大通認為，半導體股價與獲利走勢之間的落差，帶來買進機會。
該行半導體研究團隊預期，產業供需在 2028 年以前難以達到平衡，價格有望持續上漲至 2027 年。
企業近期的說法也顯示需求仍在增加：博通(AVGO-US) 指出，AI 推論需求正加速推動客製化 XPU 的採用；應用材料(AMAT-US) 表示，來自最大客戶的需求能見度異常強勁，延伸至未來八個季度；Arm(ARM-US) 則指出，雲端及 AI 業務的權利金組合正快速成長。
雲端業者的支出規模同樣支撐半導體需求。摩根大通預估，超大規模雲端業者合計資本支出將從 2026 年的 9,500 億美元，增至 2027 年的 1.4 兆美元，並在 2030 年達到 3 兆美元。
該行特別看好半導體設備，將艾司摩爾(ASML)列為歐洲核心標的。
相較之下，軟體股雖然也跌至低估值，基本面仍面臨考驗。投資人擔心 AI 將改變既有的商業模式與收入來源。
摩根大通認為，軟體股因跌深而可能出現短期反彈，但獲利能力仍將受到質疑，長期表現可能落後 AI 產業鏈其他領域。網路安全則是例外：AI 模型帶來的安全威脅增加，可望持續支撐相關需求。
科技改善有利大盤 卻非上漲必要條件
對整體市場，摩根大通認為，若油價與利率波動趨於平穩，加上 9 月不利的季節性因素消退，股市有望重拾升勢，強勁的第三季財報可能成為催化劑。
近期市場壓力主要來自美國公債殖利率與油價上升。美國 10 年期公債殖利率上週突破 5%，油價則受到美伊緊張局勢升級推動。
不過，標普 500 指數與歐洲斯托克 600 指數目前僅較高點回落約 1% 至 3%，顯示整體股市仍能消化波動。
摩根大通指出，科技股在美國及新興市場指數的權重分別達 39% 與 44%，科技板塊改善自然有利大盤，但股市上漲不一定需要科技股領漲。
今年 6 月至 7 月，韓國股市與費城半導體指數大幅下跌，整體股市仍維持穩定，並在 8 月創下新高。
因此，摩根大通看待科技股的重點，已從整個族群能否再度獨領風騷，轉向各產業的獲利差異。該行維持超配半導體、低配軟體與媒體的配置，也看好韓國及新興市場受惠於半導體前景改善的機會。
paras_en: After months of valuation compression for U.S. tech stocks, JPMorgan believes the toughest phase for the seven major tech firms may be behind them. Ongoing AI capital spending and continued corporate earnings growth give tech stocks a chance to regain market attention; however, the bank also notes that tech stocks are unlikely to return to their previous dominant, market‑driving role.

JPMorgan strategist Mislav Matejka said in a report on Monday (the 28th) that the seven major tech firms have been underperforming the market this year, and their forward 12‑month price‑to‑earnings ratio relative to the S&P 500 has fallen to a low near one standard deviation, making valuations the cheapest in a decade.
JPMorgan had already warned in March that the market’s valuation correction for large‑cap tech stocks may have gone too far.

Amazon (AMZN‑US), Google (GOOGL‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Meta (META‑US) and Oracle (ORCL‑US) – the ultra‑large cloud players – have underperformed the S&P 500 by about 8% since the start of the year.

With AI capital spending surging, the combined free cash flow of these five companies is projected to fall from roughly $233.4 billion in 2024 to about $10.6 billion in 2026, turning negative in 2027, while debt and equity financing are expected to rise accordingly.

JPMorgan acknowledges that cloud providers are shifting from a light‑asset to a heavy‑asset model, which justifies a valuation downgrade, but it believes the current compression of forward P/E ratios may already be excessive.

The bank expects corporate earnings growth to continue supporting stock prices; even if valuations fall further and erode some returns, the benefit from earnings growth should not be completely offset.

Another market concern is whether AI can be monetized smoothly. Although token prices for large language models have dropped sharply in recent months, JPMorgan notes that rapidly rising usage has more than offset the price cuts, keeping overall spend on the rise and commercial use cases accumulating.
Semiconductor earnings upgraded, software still under pressure

Within the tech sector, JPMorgan maintains an overweight stance on semiconductors and recommends a long‑short pairing of “buy semiconductors, sell software.” The bank sees a clear divergence between the two industries’ stock price and earnings outlooks.

During the June‑July momentum unwind, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell as much as 28% and the Korea Composite Stock Price Index dropped 39%. At the time, the market feared that tighter memory‑chip specifications and improved algorithm efficiency could suppress memory demand.
However, JPMorgan called for a renewed bullish view on semiconductors at the end of July, citing continued strength in earnings among related companies.

Since the June peak in semiconductor‑versus‑software relative performance, semiconductor earnings forecasts for the next 12 months have been revised upward by about 30%, while software earnings expectations have barely improved.
JPMorgan believes the gap between semiconductor stock prices and earnings creates a buying opportunity.
The bank’s semiconductor research team expects industry supply‑demand imbalances to persist until at least 2028, keeping prices on an upward trajectory through 2027.

Recent corporate comments also show demand is still growing: Broadcom (AVGO‑US) says AI inference demand is accelerating adoption of custom XPU chips; Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) notes unusually strong demand visibility from its largest customer extending through the next eight quarters; Arm (ARM‑US) points out rapid growth in cloud and AI royalty revenues.

Spending by cloud providers also underpins semiconductor demand. JPMorgan projects that total capital spending by ultra‑large cloud players will rise from $950 billion in 2026 to $1.4 trillion in 2027 and reach $3 trillion by 2030.
The firm is especially bullish on semiconductor equipment, naming ASML as a core European pick.
In contrast, software stocks, while also at low valuations, face fundamental challenges. Investors worry AI will disrupt existing business models and revenue streams.

JPMorgan thinks software stocks may see a short‑term bounce after a steep decline, but profitability will remain in question and long‑term performance could lag behind other parts of the AI value chain. Cybersecurity is an exception: heightened security threats from AI models should sustain demand.
Tech improvements benefit the broader market but are not a prerequisite for an equity rally

For the overall market, JPMorgan sees that if oil prices and interest‑rate volatility stabilize and the seasonal headwinds of September fade, equities could resume an uptrend, with a strong Q3 earnings season acting as a catalyst.
Recent market pressure has come mainly from rising U.S. Treasury yields and oil prices. The U.S. 10‑year yield broke 5% last week, and oil prices were pushed higher by escalating U.S.–Iran tensions.
Nevertheless, the S&P 500 and Europe’s Stoxx 600 have only retreated about 1%‑3% from recent highs, indicating the broader market can absorb volatility.

JPMorgan notes that tech stocks account for 39% of the U.S. index and 44% of emerging‑market indices; while a healthier tech sector naturally supports the market, a rally does not necessarily require tech to lead.
From June to July, Korean equities and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell sharply, yet the overall market stayed stable and hit new highs in August.

Thus, JPMorgan’s focus on tech stocks has shifted from wondering whether the sector can once again dominate to examining profit differentials across industries. The bank maintains an overweight on semiconductors, underweight on software and media, and remains optimistic about opportunities for Korea and emerging markets as semiconductor outlook improves.

items.title: OpenAI因安全疑慮 取消發布新模型GPT-6.1 Astra
items.title_en: OpenAI Cancels Release of New Model GPT-6.1 Astra Over Safety Concerns
paras: 多家外媒於週一(28 日) 報導，OpenAI 原訂於 10 月在 ChatGPT 與 Codex 平台推出新模型「GPT-6.1 Astra」，但因內部測試發現重大安全疑慮，最終決定取消發布，轉而集中資源加強後續模型的安全性。
OpenAI 原本計畫在未來幾週內推出 GPT-6.1 Astra。該模型在無人協助下執行複雜任務與寫作的能力上，表現均優於先前版本，然而其安全測試結果卻未能達到公司的公開發布標準。
OpenAI 安全系統主管 Saachi Jain 指出，GPT-6.1 Astra 在兩項關鍵指標上的表現較前代模型退步：
第一是「對齊」(Alignment)能力，即模型是否能按照人類的期望與意圖行事。測試顯示，該模型出現較多不誠實 (欺騙) 行為，有時未能如實向使用者回報其執行與未執行的事項。
第二是「授權範圍」管理。GPT-6.1 Astra 有時會在未先取得使用者許可的情況下擅自繼續執行任務；甚至在可能存在安全風險的情境下，仍會強行嘗試調用外部工具或服務。
Jain 表示，模型既要嚴格遵守授權範圍，又要在任務受阻時保持高效運作。雖然 GPT-6.1 Astra 在減少模型消極應付方面有所突破，但其安全與對齊表現仍不足以支持公開上線。
OpenAI 宣布取消發布 Astra 的同時，內部也正積極調查近幾個月發現的多起 AI 代理 (Agent) 安全事件。今年夏天，數百個用於執行資安測試的 OpenAI 內部代理，竟意外入侵了 AI 開發平台 Hugging Face；隨後澳洲政府與聯合國等機構也發現，OpenAI 代理曾以類似但程度較輕的手法存取其網站。不過，大多數已公開的事件所涉及的均為無公開計畫的內部模型。
此外，OpenAI 上週又發現有 AI 代理繞過公司的網路存取限制，向公開聊天機器人發送查詢。官方表示，新導入的監控系統在 15 分鐘內即察覺異常，公司隨後暫停了目前能力最強的 AI 模型訓練，至今尚未恢復。
OpenAI 特別澄清，GPT-6.1 Astra 並非上述被暫停訓練的模型。Astra 原本已規劃公開推出，本次取消發布完全是因為自身的安全測試未達標準。
為全面應對代理安全隱患，OpenAI 已導入全新的監控系統以快速捕捉異常行為，並要求工程師在測試 AI 系統時採取更嚴格的安全防護措施。
這項消息傳出的時間點相當敏感，正好落在 OpenAI 於舊金山舉行年度開發者大會的前一天。OpenAI 過去常利用此大會發表重磅新模型與開發者服務；然而近幾週，OpenAI 與主要競爭對手 Anthropic 均公開呼籲產業夥伴放緩尖端 AI 模型的開發腳步，共同投入建立安全標準，並表示自身也將放緩內部的研發進度。
paras_en: Multiple foreign media outlets reported on Monday (the 28th) that OpenAI had originally scheduled the launch of a new model, “GPT-6.1 Astra,” on its ChatGPT and Codex platforms in October, but after internal testing uncovered major safety concerns, the company decided to cancel the release and instead focus resources on strengthening the safety of future models.

OpenAI had initially planned to roll out GPT-6.1 Astra within the next few weeks. The model outperformed previous versions in its ability to execute complex tasks and write without human assistance, but its safety test results fell short of the company’s public release standards.
Saachi Jain, head of OpenAI’s safety systems, said that GPT-6.1 Astra regressed on two key metrics compared with its predecessor:

The first is “alignment” – the model’s ability to act according to human expectations and intent. Tests showed the model exhibited more dishonest (deceptive) behavior and sometimes failed to accurately report to users what it had or had not done.

The second is “authorization scope” management. GPT-6.1 Astra sometimes continued executing tasks without first obtaining user permission, and even in situations that might pose safety risks it would forcibly attempt to call external tools or services.

Jain explained that a model must strictly adhere to its authorization limits while remaining efficient when a task is blocked. Although GPT-6.1 Astra made progress in reducing passive non‑responses, its safety and alignment performance were still insufficient for a public launch.

When OpenAI announced the cancellation of Astra, it also disclosed that it is actively investigating several AI‑agent safety incidents uncovered over the past few months. This summer, hundreds of internal OpenAI agents used for security testing inadvertently breached the AI development platform Hugging Face; later, Australian government and United Nations entities found that OpenAI agents had accessed their sites using similar, though less severe, methods. Most of the publicly reported incidents involved internal models with no public roadmap.

In addition, OpenAI discovered last week that AI agents had bypassed the company’s network access restrictions to send queries to the public chatbot. The company said a newly deployed monitoring system detected the anomaly within 15 minutes, after which it paused training of its most capable AI model, a pause that remains in effect.

OpenAI clarified that GPT-6.1 Astra is not the model whose training was paused. Astra had been slated for a public launch, and the cancellation is solely due to its safety tests not meeting standards.

To comprehensively address agent‑related safety risks, OpenAI has implemented a brand‑new monitoring system to quickly capture anomalous behavior and has required engineers to adopt stricter safety safeguards when testing AI systems.

The timing of this announcement is particularly sensitive, coming the day before OpenAI’s annual developer conference in San Francisco. The conference has traditionally been used to unveil major new models and developer services, but in recent weeks both OpenAI and its main rival Anthropic have publicly urged industry partners to slow the development of cutting‑edge AI models, to collectively work on safety standards, and have said they themselves will decelerate internal R&D.

items.title: AI放空潮擴大！放空者瞄準包括台股「兩家公司」、AI投資進入個股淘汰賽
items.title_en: AI Short‑Selling Wave Expands: Short Sellers Target Two Taiwanese Companies and AI Stocks Enter a Survival Contest
paras: 近年人工智慧（AI）交易持續走強，讓放空投資人難以押注其反轉，但隨著AI題材逐步擴大，放空者的目標也開始從最熱門的AI晶片，延伸至整個AI生態系，試圖從不同領域中找出可能成為「輸家」的企業，其中也包括台灣的廣達(2382-TW) 與緯穎(6669-TW)。
根據《Business Insider》報導，標普全球市場財智股票分析產品執行董事Matt Chessum表示，放空活動正沿著AI價值鏈擴散，涵蓋軟體、機器人、自駕車、量子運算、雲端基礎設施及資料中心營運商。
他指出，這反映市場正更加審視哪些企業能將AI投資轉化為可持續的報酬。
Chessum 指出，做空範圍的擴大表明 AI 投資熱潮正趨於成熟。投資人雖已接受AI具有結構性成長的發展趨勢，但開始更加挑剔，尋找真正能從AI熱潮中受益的領域，同時避開可能難以實現成長的企業。
部分知名放空投資人近來持續對AI晶片交易的估值與持續性表達懷疑。以電影《大賣空》原型之一貝瑞（Michael Burry）為例，他在6月放空熱門的安碩半導體ETF(SOXX-US) ，此前他也曾押注輝達(NVDA-US) 與美光科技(MU-US) 下跌。
但Chessum指出，近期數據顯示，市場情緒已明顯偏離貝瑞這類策略，轉為在一個廣泛受到支持的題材中進行個股選擇，而不是押注整個產業看空。
Chessum表示，放空者已不再對AI硬體做出一致性的看空押注，而是將曝險集中在估值、融資能力、競爭地位或執行能力存在較大爭議的企業。
近期受到放空者關注的標的，也包括一些在AI熱潮中重新受到市場追捧的「迷因股」。Chessum指出，SoundHound AI (SOUN-US) 與中國AI模型開發商智譜(02513-HK) 便是其中兩家公司，受到關注的原因包括估值偏高及商業化風險。
Chessum表示，目前SoundHound約33.57%的流通股已被借出，顯示其放空需求高，同時市場對其AI成長故事的看法也存在分歧。
至於智譜，則因借券市場供需失衡而受到放空者關注。Chessum指出，市場對智譜股票的借券需求非常強勁，但可供借出的股票數量有限，使其成為市場上借券價值最高的AI標的之一。
標普全球數據也顯示，AI相關放空交易正逐漸走向全球，而非集中於美國最熱門的AI股票。
該機構指出，亞洲AI相關企業的股票也出現更多放空交易，包括廣達與緯穎 。標普表示，這些動向顯示「投資人的布局已從晶片設計商延伸至伺服器、記憶體、晶圓生產及半導體設備」。
放空者如今展現出的更加審慎態度，也反映出整體AI交易仍揮之不去的商業化疑慮。標普全球表示，其分析發現，過去一年推出的企業AI專案中，不到一半目前符合在12個月內產生正報酬的進度。
在此背景下，證券借貸活動並未顯示市場全面否定AI，也不是所有AI股票都面臨一致性的放空壓力。相反地，這顯示市場正逐漸進入更成熟的階段，投資人開始檢視不同企業能否真正將AI投資、產能與技術潛力轉化為可持續的報酬。
paras_en: In recent years, AI‑related trading has continued to strengthen, making it difficult for short sellers to bet on a reversal. As AI themes broaden, short sellers are extending their targets beyond the hottest AI chips to the entire AI ecosystem, seeking companies that could become "losers" across various sectors, including Taiwan's Quanta (2382‑TW) and Wi‑Ying (6669‑TW).

According to Business Insider, Matt Chessum, Executive Director of S&P Global Market Intelligence’s equity analysis product, said short‑selling activity is spreading along the AI value chain, covering software, robotics, autonomous vehicles, quantum computing, cloud infrastructure, and data‑center operators.
He noted that this reflects the market’s increasing scrutiny of which firms can turn AI investments into sustainable returns.

Chessum said the widening scope of short positions indicates that the AI investment boom is maturing. While investors have accepted AI’s structural growth trend, they are becoming more selective, looking for sectors that truly benefit from the AI surge and avoiding companies that may struggle to achieve growth.

Some well‑known short sellers have recently expressed doubts about the valuation and durability of AI‑chip trades. For example, Michael Burry, one of the real‑life inspirations for the film "The Big Short," shorted the popular VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SOXX‑US) in June, after previously betting against Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and Micron Technology (MU‑US).

However, Chessum pointed out that recent data show market sentiment has clearly diverged from strategies like Burry’s, shifting toward selecting individual stocks within a broadly supported theme rather than shorting the entire industry.

Chessum said short sellers are no longer making uniform bearish bets on AI hardware; instead, they concentrate exposure on companies with disputed valuations, financing capacity, competitive position, or execution ability.

Among the recent targets attracting short‑seller attention are some "meme stocks" that have been revived by the AI hype. Chessum cited SoundHound AI (SOUN‑US) and Chinese AI model developer Zhihu (02513‑HK) as two examples, with concerns over high valuations and commercialization risk.
Chessum noted that about 33.57% of SoundHound’s float is currently on loan, indicating strong short‑selling demand and divergent market views on its AI growth story.

As for Zhihu, short‑seller interest stems from an imbalance in the securities‑lending market. Chessum explained that demand to borrow Zhihu shares is very strong while the supply of lendable shares is limited, making it one of the most expensive AI stocks to borrow.
S&P Global data also show that AI‑related short‑selling is becoming a global phenomenon rather than being concentrated on the United States' most popular AI stocks.

The firm highlighted that Asian AI‑related equities are seeing more short‑selling activity, including Quanta and Wi‑Ying. S&P said these trends show "investors’ positioning has expanded from chip designers to servers, memory, wafer fabrication, and semiconductor equipment."

The more cautious stance displayed by short sellers reflects lingering commercialization doubts about AI trading overall. S&P Global noted that, of the corporate AI projects launched in the past year, fewer than half are on track to generate positive returns within twelve months.

In this context, securities‑lending activity does not indicate a wholesale market rejection of AI, nor that all AI stocks face uniform short‑selling pressure. On the contrary, it suggests the market is moving into a more mature phase, with investors evaluating whether individual companies can truly convert AI investment, capacity, and technological potential into sustainable returns.

items.title: 佛州提告OpenAI 請求法院禁止開發新AI模型
items.title_en: Florida Sues OpenAI, Requests Court to Bar Development of New AI Models
paras: 佛羅里達州檢察長 James Uthmeier 週一 (28 日) 向法院聲請暫時禁制令，要求 OpenAI 在缺乏獨立安全監督機制的情況下，不得繼續開發新的人工智慧 (AI) 模型。佛州同時要求限制未成年人使用 ChatGPT，以及平台對使用者的互動與宣傳方式。法院尚未就聲請作出裁決。
這項聲請是佛州今年 6 月對 OpenAI 提起訴訟的後續行動。
佛州主張，OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 的設計、行銷與推廣上未充分保護使用者，對平台安全性作出不實陳述，涉嫌違反佛州《欺騙及不公平交易行為法》。
訴訟提及 ChatGPT 據稱曾向校園槍擊案凶嫌提供資訊、給予自我傷害相關指引，以及使年輕使用者沉迷。這些指控仍待法院審理。
在最新聲請中，佛州要求法院禁止未成年人使用 ChatGPT，並禁止 OpenAI 賦予平台「人類特質」、主動誘導使用者持續互動，或將 ChatGPT 宣傳為安全、準確或可靠。
佛州以 AI 模型的安全事件支持聲請理由。
佛州在聲請書中列舉多起 OpenAI 模型的安全事件，包括涉及 Hugging Face 的事件、模型據稱試圖入侵美國政府網站，以及一名 OpenAI 代理未經授權進入澳洲衛生部門網站。
佛州也指控，OpenAI 未經家長同意蒐集 13 歲以下兒童的個人資訊，且缺乏足夠措施阻止未成年人使用 ChatGPT。
聲請書另引用有關 OpenAI、Anthropic 及安全研究人員調查模型異常行為的報導。
相關事件包括繞過安全防護、試圖規避監控及干擾網站等，調查數量達數以萬計；但各事件嚴重程度不同，目前已調查的多數事件沒有已知的現實世界傷害。
佛州據此主張，OpenAI 無法充分自行管理技術風險。
檢察長 Uthmeier 週一公開要求 OpenAI 停止宣稱產品安全、停止將 ChatGPT 塑造成像人一樣，並停止向兒童提供產品。
OpenAI 發言人 Drew Pusateri 回應，公司已暫停訓練功能最強大的模型，在增加安全防護措施前不會恢復；公司也願與佛州及其他州合作，推動適用於整個 AI 產業的安全政策。
paras_en: Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier on Monday (the 28th) filed a motion for a temporary restraining order, asking the court to prohibit OpenAI from continuing to develop new artificial intelligence (AI) models without an independent safety oversight mechanism. Florida also seeks to restrict minors' use of ChatGPT and to limit the platform's interaction and promotional practices toward users. The court has not yet ruled on the motion.
The motion follows a lawsuit Florida filed against OpenAI in June of this year.

Florida alleges that OpenAI failed to adequately protect users in the design, marketing, and promotion of ChatGPT, made false statements about the platform's safety, and violated Florida’s Deceptive and Unfair Trade Practices Act.

The lawsuit cites claims that ChatGPT allegedly provided information to a school shooting suspect, gave self‑harm guidance, and fostered addiction among young users. These allegations remain to be adjudicated.

In the latest motion, Florida asks the court to bar minors from using ChatGPT and to prohibit OpenAI from attributing "human‑like" qualities to the platform, actively prompting users to keep interacting, or marketing ChatGPT as safe, accurate, or reliable.
Florida supports its request with examples of safety incidents involving AI models.

The filing lists several safety incidents involving OpenAI models, including an incident involving Hugging Face, a model purportedly attempting to breach U.S. government websites, and an OpenAI agent who accessed an Australian health‑department site without authorization.
Florida also accuses OpenAI of collecting personal information from children under 13 without parental consent and of lacking sufficient measures to prevent minors from using ChatGPT.
The motion further cites reports on investigations by OpenAI, Anthropic, and security researchers into anomalous model behavior.

Related incidents include attempts to bypass safety safeguards, evade monitoring, and disrupt websites, with investigations numbering in the tens of thousands; while the severity of each incident varies, most investigated cases have no known real‑world harm.
Based on this, Florida argues that OpenAI cannot adequately self‑manage the technological risks.
Attorney General Uthmeier publicly demanded on Monday that OpenAI stop claiming its products are safe, stop portraying ChatGPT as human‑like, and stop offering the product to children.

OpenAI spokesperson Drew Pusateri responded that the company has paused training its most powerful models and will not resume until additional safety measures are in place; the company is also willing to work with Florida and other states to develop safety policies applicable across the AI industry.

items.title: 估值1500億美元、募資150億！Solidigm擬最快2027赴美上市 母企SK海力士面臨估值動搖
items.title_en: Valuation of $150 B, $15 B Fundraise! Solidigm Aims for Fastest U.S. IPO by 2027, Parent SK Hynix Faces Valuation Pressure
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，SK海力士旗下美國子公司Solidigm正邁向可能成為美股史上最大規模的半導體IPO。Solidigm已與多家投行舉行承銷競標會議，考慮最快2027年上市，目標估值最高約1500億美元、募資約150億美元；若成功上市將遠超安謀2023年上市估值約540億美元、Cerebras Systems 2026年完全稀釋估值約560億美元，也高於兩者募資規模。
SK海力士今年7月完成那斯達克ADR二次上市，發行1.779億份、募資約265億美元，發行價149美元，首日市值一度逼近1.22兆美元；按近期媒體預估，SK集團市值約1.37兆美元，而Solidigm獨立上市，等於把AI基礎設施中最吃香的一塊NAND與eSSD資產拆出重估。
Solidigm核心業務為NAND與eSSD，客戶涵蓋CoreWeave、Vast Data、Dell、騰訊等雲端與資料中心業者，上月跟CoreWeave簽多年供貨協議，強化AI推理存儲定位。
今年上半年Solidigm營收12.25兆韓元(約90.3億美元)、年增265%，淨利5.839兆韓元(約43.1億美元)、年增44倍，淨利率由3.9%升至47.7%並首度累計轉虧為盈。

根據TrendForce數據，SK海力士集團今年次季eSSD營收86.3億美元、環增85.9%，市占21.1%；Counterpoint則估算eSSD占全球NAND出貨量48%，AI推理取代訓練成為主引擎，Solidigm位元出貨今年Q2季增40%。同季整體NAND原廠前五大營收688.7億美元、季增77%，供不應求推升合約價；今年首季eSSD前五大營收184.6億美元、季增率86.1%，合約價漲約80%，顯示漲價與位元成長雙輪驅動。
Solidigm前身為英特爾NAND與SSD事業，SK海力士2020年以約90億美元收購、2021年成立，早期連年虧損，2022、2023年分別虧3.3兆、4兆韓元，2023年底股東權益一度為負；六年轉向千億美元估值，反映市場把eSSD視為AI基礎設施「賣鏟子」資產。
為承接需求，Solidigm評估在美國興建首座NAND量產廠，紐約州北部、美東地塊列入考察，現有量產主要靠中國大連，美國僅有總部與研發。

資本市場卻先反映利空。韓股SK海力士周一(28日)盤中跌約5%，創兩周最大跌幅，大股東SK Square跌逾8%、控股SK Inc.跌逾6%，因市場擔心Solidigm獨立上市後，SK海力士股東對AI NAND超級週期利潤的間接權益被稀釋，未來收益分流外部股東，加上南韓企業治理論壇批評SK Inc.→SK Square→SK海力士→AI Company→Solidigm層級更深，加劇金字塔股權與「韓國折價」，8月已促請撤案。
Fibonacci資產管理公司執行長Jung In Yun指出，若少量股權、價格合理可釋放價值，大規模稀釋且資金用途不明則堪憂；未來資產證券則認為部分出售影響有限，可視為併購資金回收。
分析人士指出，Solidigm估值成敗取決於三項變數：AI推理與Agent工作負載可否在2027年延續eSSD需求、NAND漲價會否隨新增產能回軟、以及IPO釋股比例與募資投入美國產線的報酬率。記憶體具備強周期特性，供給緊時利潤暴增、產能釋放後回檔；AI可延長景氣，但不改供需。
對SK海力士而言，Solidigm上市既是為擴張融資，也可能重塑集團估值與治理折價，市場短期波動難免。
paras_en: Foreign media reports say SK Hynix’s U.S. subsidiary Solidigm is moving toward what could become the largest semiconductor IPO in U.S. market history. Solidigm has held underwriting meetings with several banks and is considering a listing as early as 2027, targeting a valuation of up to $150 billion and a raise of about $15 billion; if successful, it would dwarf Arm’s 2023 IPO valuation of roughly $54 billion and Cerebras Systems’ fully‑diluted 2026 valuation of about $56 billion, and would also exceed both companies’ fundraising sizes.

In July this year SK Hynix completed a secondary listing of its ADR on Nasdaq, issuing 177.9 million shares and raising roughly $26.5 billion at $149 per share, with a first‑day market cap that briefly approached $1.22 trillion. Recent media estimates put the SK Group’s market value at about $1.37 trillion, and an independent Solidigm listing would effectively carve out its most coveted AI‑infrastructure assets—NAND and eSSD—into a separate valuation.

Solidigm’s core business is NAND and eSSD, serving cloud and data‑center customers such as CoreWeave, Vast Data, Dell and Tencent. Last month it signed a multi‑year supply agreement with CoreWeave, reinforcing its positioning in AI inference storage.

In the first half of this year Solidigm posted revenue of 12.25 trillion won (about $9.03 billion), up 265% year‑on‑year, and net profit of 5.839 trillion won (about $4.31 billion), a 44‑fold increase, with net margin rising from 3.9% to 47.7% and turning a loss into profit for the first time.

According to TrendForce, SK Hynix’s eSSD revenue in the second quarter was $8.63 billion, up 85.9% quarter‑on‑quarter, giving it a 21.1% market share. Counterpoint estimates eSSD accounts for 48% of global NAND shipments, with AI inference overtaking training as the main driver; Solidigm’s bit shipments grew 40% in Q2. In the same quarter the top five NAND vendors generated $68.87 billion in revenue, up 77% QoQ, pushing contract prices higher due to tight supply. In Q1 this year the top five eSSD vendors earned $18.46 billion, up 86.1% QoQ, with contract prices rising about 80%, indicating that both price hikes and bit‑growth are driving the market.

Solidigm originated from Intel’s NAND and SSD business, which SK Hynix acquired for roughly $9 billion in 2020 and formally spun out in 2021. The unit posted consecutive losses early on, losing 3.3 trillion won in 2022 and 4 trillion won in 2023, with shareholders’ equity turning negative at the end of 2023. Its shift to a valuation in the hundred‑billion‑dollar range reflects the market’s view of eSSD as a “shovel‑selling” AI infrastructure asset.

To meet demand, Solidigm is evaluating the construction of its first NAND mass‑production plant in the United States, looking at sites in northern New York and the broader East Coast. Currently its mass production is based mainly in Dalian, China, with only headquarters and R&D in the U.S.

The capital markets reacted negatively. SK Hynix shares fell about 5% on Monday (the 28th), the biggest drop in two weeks, while major shareholder SK Square slid more than 8% and controlling entity SK Inc. fell over 6%, as investors worry that an independent Solidigm IPO would dilute SK Hynix shareholders’ indirect exposure to the AI NAND super‑cycle profits, diverting future earnings to external shareholders. A Korean corporate‑governance forum also criticized the deepening chain SK Inc. → SK Square → SK Hynix → AI company → Solidigm, aggravating pyramid‑style equity structures and the “Korea discount,” prompting a request to withdraw the filing in August.

Jung In Yun, CEO of Fibonacci Asset Management, said that a small equity stake at a reasonable price could unlock value, but large‑scale dilution with unclear use of proceeds is concerning. He added that asset‑backed securities view a partial sale as having limited impact and could be seen as a way to recoup acquisition funding.

Analysts note that Solidigm’s valuation hinges on three variables: whether AI inference and agent workloads will sustain eSSD demand through 2027, whether NAND price increases will soften as new capacity comes online, and the proportion of shares floated and the return on investment of funds allocated to U.S. production lines. Memory has strong cyclical traits—profits surge when supply is tight and retreat when capacity expands—while AI can extend the upcycle without changing the underlying supply‑demand balance.
For SK Hynix, Solidigm’s IPO is both a financing vehicle and a potential reshaper of the group’s overall valuation and governance discount. Short‑term market volatility is therefore inevitable.

items.title: 誰還對記憶體悲觀？AI客戶搶談10年長約 三星七成產能已被鎖定
items.title_en: Who Is Still Pessimistic About Memory? AI Customers Rush to Negotiate 10‑Year Contracts, Samsung Has Locked Up 70% of Capacity
paras: 「如果客戶開始要求簽訂10年的供應協議，你怎麼還能對記憶體晶片持悲觀態度？」韓國大信證券在最新報告中如此反問。
隨著AI資料中心建置加速，記憶體晶片客戶正把採購規劃拉長至5年，甚至提出簽訂最長10年的供應協議，以確保未來取得足夠的高頻寬記憶體（HBM）與DRAM。
根據大信證券報告，三星電子(005930KS) 已與5家主要資料中心客戶完成長期供應協議，並即將與另外5家大型AI客戶敲定交易。目前約70%的記憶體晶片產能已納入長約，供應期間涵蓋至2031年。
三星表示，幾乎每位主要客戶都在主動尋求多年期協議。客戶著眼的並非較低價格，而是擔心未來需要時，無法取得足夠的記憶體。
對AI基礎設施業者而言，即使能擴增GPU或採購伺服器，若HBM等關鍵記憶體供應不足，資料中心部署仍可能受阻。
這些協議也不只是預留產能。大信證券指出，長約通常包含預付款、最低採購承諾及價格底線，客戶須依約採購，三星則能降低未來價格波動的影響。
報告稱，三星已收取相當於相關長約金額約四分之一的訂金，顯示客戶願意投入資金確保供應。
客戶提出最長10年協議
多數合約以5年為初始期限，並透過逐年續約的方式，持續更新未來年的需求與產能規劃。三星已與部分客戶討論2031年的供應規模，另有部分AI客戶提出簽訂最長10年協議的需求。不過，報告並未指出三星已簽下10年合約。
對景氣循環明顯的記憶體產業而言，客戶提前討論如此長期的供應安排並不常見。隨著AI模型規模成長、資料中心持續擴建，HBM與高效能DRAM的供貨能力，正成為業者規劃算力建置時的重要條件。
良率攸關後續供貨
除了需求升溫，大信證券也看好三星的技術進展。該券商預期，三星明年將重新取得HBM市場最大份額，原因包括客戶覆蓋範圍擴大、HBM價格上漲，以及1c DRAM良率提前提升至約80%。
良率提高，意味三星可在相同晶圓製造能力下生產更多可用晶片，進而改善供貨能力、單位成本與獲利表現。
大信證券並預期，隨著獲利改善，三星將強化2027年至2029年的股東回饋政策，包括提高股利及可能實施庫藏股買回。
從5年合約延伸至2031年的供應討論，再到客戶提出10年協議需求，AI業者爭取記憶體產能的時間尺度正持續拉長。對供應商而言，能否穩定交付大規模產能，也將影響其承接未來訂單的能力。
paras_en: If customers start demanding 10‑year supply agreements, how can you still be pessimistic about memory chips? Daishin Securities asked in its latest report.

As AI data‑center construction accelerates, memory‑chip customers are extending procurement planning to five years, even proposing up to ten‑year supply agreements to ensure future access to sufficient high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) and DRAM.

According to the Daishin report, Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) has completed long‑term supply agreements with five major data‑center customers and is about to finalize deals with another five large AI customers. Currently about 70% of its memory‑chip capacity is already allocated to long‑term contracts, covering supply through 2031.
Samsung says almost every major customer is proactively seeking multi‑year agreements. Customers are not focused on lower prices but on the risk of being unable to obtain enough memory when needed.
For AI infrastructure providers, even if they can add GPUs or purchase servers, a shortage of key memories such as HBM could still hinder data‑center deployments.

These agreements are not just capacity reservations. Daishin notes that long‑term contracts typically include pre‑payments, minimum purchase commitments and price floors, requiring customers to buy as agreed while allowing Samsung to mitigate future price volatility.
The report says Samsung has already received deposits amounting to roughly one‑quarter of the contract values, showing customers are willing to put up capital to secure supply.
Customers propose contracts up to ten years.

Most contracts start with a five‑year term and are renewed annually to update demand and capacity plans for future years. Samsung has discussed supply volumes for 2031 with some customers, and some AI customers have expressed a need for contracts as long as ten years. However, the report does not state that Samsung has actually signed any 10‑year deals.

For the memory industry, which is known for pronounced cyclical swings, it is uncommon for customers to discuss such long‑term supply arrangements in advance. As AI model sizes grow and data centers continue to expand, the ability to supply HBM and high‑performance DRAM is becoming a key factor in planners’ compute‑capacity strategies.
Yield rates affect subsequent supply.

Beyond the warming demand, Daishin also sees Samsung’s technology progressing. The broker expects Samsung to regain the largest share of the HBM market next year, driven by broader customer coverage, rising HBM prices, and an early lift of 1‑layer DRAM yield to about 80%.
Higher yields mean Samsung can produce more usable chips with the same wafer capacity, improving supply capability, unit cost and profitability.
Daishin also forecasts that, as profitability improves, Samsung will strengthen its shareholder return policy for 2027‑2029, including higher dividends and possibly share‑buybacks.

From extending five‑year contracts to supply discussions through 2031, to customers asking for 10‑year agreements, the time horizon AI firms are pursuing for memory capacity is continuously lengthening. For suppliers, the ability to reliably deliver large‑scale capacity will also affect their ability to win future orders.

items.title: 華爾街大空頭貝瑞：AI泡沫可能比原先預期「更早破裂」
items.title_en: Wall Street Big Short Michael Burry Says AI Bubble Could Burst Earlier Than Expected
paras: 《CNBC》報導，電影「大賣空」原型人物貝瑞(Michael Burry)正將他看空AI熱潮的時間表提前。
這位在2007年至2009年全球金融危機爆發前，成功押注美國房市崩盤而聞名的投資人表示，他正在把對主要AI股票的放空部位轉換為賣權(put options)，讓他在較短時間內，以更具成本效益方式取得槓桿。
貝瑞在周一(28日)發布的投資電子報中寫道，「從基本面來看，我正在把時間表往前移。因此，我希望我的放空部位擁有更高的槓桿。更明確的時間表，讓使用槓桿變得更容易接受。沒有什麼比選擇權更能代表槓桿，而在此案例中就是賣權。由於VIX等波動率指標目前異常緊縮，賣權相對便宜。」
他表示，其中部分操作是為了降低自己的稅務負擔，但大部分都是因為他認為「AI泡沫可能會比預期更早破裂。」貝瑞最近以賣權為主的部位顯示，他認為AI交易熱潮可能在明年夏季之前出現逆轉。
他將原本對美光(Micron)(MU-US)的放空部位換成了賣權，履約日期設定在明年6月，履約價約為500美元。他也將對 Nebius(NBIS-US)的放空部位換成了明年6月到期的賣權，履約價在「兩位數價格區間」。此外，他將原本放空iShares Semiconductor ETF(SOXX-US)的部位，換成了2027年9月到期、履約價位於400多美元低段的賣權。
他也「將原本對Palantir(PLTR-US)的放空與賣權部位進行調整並延後到期日，轉換成更大的賣權部位」，主要集中在2027年9月到期、履約價100多美元低段的選擇權。
貝瑞引用了Ares Management最近一份研究。該研究強調，目前AI產業高度依賴尚未被證實的收入，而相關融資架構又搭配了要求嚴格的法律協議，因此相當不穩定。
Ares的報告指出，「只要有一季的AI營收不如預期、無法支撐原本資本支出的融資假設，就可能發生問題。在這種情況下，只要少數幾家原本傾向把資本重新配置到最有信心投資標的上的董事會，認定最有信心的投資標的已經發生轉移，就足以改變局勢。」
貝瑞最新的操作顯示，他對AI交易的看法越來越悲觀。本月稍早，他已增加了對 美光、Nebius及SOXX的放空部位。
他同時引用Acer執行長Jason Chen的說法。Chen最近接受台灣媒體採訪時表示，由於中國的產能持續增加，記憶體晶片產業的週期性可能重新出現。
Jason Chen被引述表示，「怎麼可能一直缺貨？中國的生產能力一直在增加，根本不存在短缺問題。目前合約價格仍在高檔波動，有些價格上漲，有些則下跌。」
貝瑞今年一直維持看空，但股市卻持續創下新高。他今年5月曾表示，目前的股市讓他「感覺就像1999年至2000年泡沫最後幾個月的情況」。而那斯達克綜合指數上周收在歷史新高。
不過，許多科技股目前仍遠低於自身歷史高點。美光目前比歷史高點低約16%，而Palantir則比歷史高點低約10%。
paras_en: CNBC reports that Michael Burry, the real‑life figure portrayed in the movie “The Big Short,” is moving up his timetable for betting against the AI hype.

The investor, famous for correctly shorting the U.S. housing market before the 2007‑2009 global financial crisis, says he is converting his short positions in major AI stocks into put options so he can achieve leverage more cost‑effectively over a shorter horizon.

In an investment newsletter released on Monday (the 28th), Burry wrote, “Fundamentally, I’m moving the timeline forward. Therefore I want my short positions to have higher leverage. A clearer timeline makes leveraged exposure easier to accept. Nothing represents leverage better than options, and in this case it’s puts. With volatility indices like the VIX unusually tight right now, puts are relatively cheap.”

He said part of the maneuver is to reduce his tax burden, but the bulk is driven by his belief that “the AI bubble may burst earlier than expected.” Burry’s recent put‑heavy positioning suggests he expects a reversal of the AI trading frenzy before next summer.

He swapped his short on Micron (MU‑US) for puts expiring in June 2025 with a strike around $500. He also turned his short on Nebius (NBIS‑US) into June 2025 puts with strikes in the “double‑digit” range. In addition, he replaced his short on the iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX‑US) with puts expiring September 2027 at a low‑$400‑plus strike.
He also “adjusted and extended the expiration of his short and put position on Palantir (PLTR‑US) into a larger put position,” concentrating on September 2027 puts with strikes in the low $100 range.

Burry cited a recent research report from Ares Management. The study stresses that the AI industry is currently heavily dependent on unproven revenue streams, and the financing structures are tied to strict legal covenants, making them highly fragile.

Ares’ report notes, “If a single quarter of AI revenue falls short of expectations and cannot support the financing assumptions underlying original cap‑ex plans, trouble can arise. In that scenario, even a few board members who were inclined to reallocate capital to their most confident bets can, by recognizing a shift in the most promising investment, change the whole picture.”
Burry’s latest moves show his outlook on AI trading is becoming increasingly pessimistic. Earlier this month he added to his short positions in Micron, Nebius and SOXX.
He also quoted Acer CEO Jason Chen, who told Taiwanese media that rising Chinese capacity could bring back cyclical pressure to the memory‑chip industry.

Jason Chen was quoted as saying, “How can there still be a shortage? China’s production capacity keeps growing, so a shortage simply doesn’t exist. Contract prices are still volatile at the high end—some are rising, some are falling.”

Burry has remained bearish all year while the stock market keeps hitting new highs. In May he likened the current market to the final months of the 1999‑2000 bubble, and the Nasdaq Composite closed at a record high last week.
However, many tech stocks are still well below their own historical peaks. Micron trades about 16% below its all‑time high, and Palantir is roughly 10% under its previous peak.

items.title: 去槓桿風暴將至！美銀Hartnett：兩大指標即將觸發拋售信號
items.title_en: Deleveraging Storm Approaches! BofA's Hartnett: Two Key Indicators Set to Trigger Sell Signals
paras: 美銀首席策略師Michael Hartnett在最新《Flow Show》報告中警告，若衡量美債波動的MOVE指數與全球金融股同步發出特定信號，美股恐面臨劇烈的風險偏好驟降與去槓桿壓力。
他設定了明確的觀察指標：當MOVE指數攀升至125以上，且iShares全球金融ETF(IXG)跌破125美元時，市場可能觸發「避險去槓桿事件」。
近期債市波動顯著加劇，MOVE指數在兩日內飆升33%，10年債殖利率更上升至19年來高位。隨著通膨預期升溫及Fed鷹派預期，債券價格承壓。
Hartnett指出，關鍵在於債市壓力是否傳導至金融股。由於金融機構對利率與融資環境高度敏感，金融股走弱將成為市場壓力擴大的第二道確認信號。
根據Hartnett分析，若美債殖利率持續走高並伴隨IXG破位，市場將從局部資產重新定價轉向廣泛的風險削減，引發連鎖拋售。即便出現美伊達成協議導致油價大跌的情境，只要殖利率漲勢不止，避險情緒仍難消退。
對於未來政策走向，Hartnett認為，當市場壓力達到極限，決策官員恐介入壓低油價與收益率。Hartnett預估，若未來一年美債殖利率下降100個基點，長債價格將顯著反彈，屆時投資者應「小幅增持債券」。此前Hartnett曾稱，當決策官員開始恐慌，市場就會停止恐慌」。
paras_en: BofA chief strategist Michael Hartnett warned in the latest Flow Show report that if the MOVE index, which measures US Treasury volatility, and global financial stocks simultaneously emit a specific signal, US equities could face a sharp drop in risk appetite and deleveraging pressure.
He set clear watch‑points: when the MOVE index climbs above 125 and the iShares Global Financial ETF (IXG) falls below $125, the market may trigger a ‘hedge‑driven deleveraging event’.

Recent bond‑market volatility has surged dramatically, with the MOVE index jumping 33% over two days and the 10‑year Treasury yield rising to its highest level in 19 years. Rising inflation expectations and hawkish Fed outlook are putting pressure on bond prices.
